$comment: The list of MCP clients the probe knows about: hosts people run, agent harnesses, and frameworks that embed an MCP client. `source` names the clone in _clients/repos.tsv. `adapter` points at probe/hosts/<id>/ when one exists. `drive` says what it takes to run a scenario: `cli` means a non-interactive command the runner can start, `script` means a short program on the framework's API, `gui` means a person has to click. `registryId` is the id in data/clients.json when the client has an entry there.

codex.title: Codex CLI
codex.notes: codex exec with a custom model provider on the Responses API.

goose.title: goose
goose.notes: goose run --no-session with OPENAI_BASE_URL or ANTHROPIC_HOST.

mastra.title: Mastra
mastra.notes: Agent plus MCPClient on a model config with a custom url.

fx.title: fx (native engine)
fx.notes: fx ask with a configured openai-chat-completions provider. Runs from WSL on Windows.

libfx.title: libfx (fx JavaScript adapter)
libfx.notes: createMcpAdapter over the official TypeScript client.

eve.title: eve
eve.notes: eve dev --no-ui plus eve remote connect --print against a generated app; http only, MCP tools reached through eve__tool.

opencode.title: opencode
opencode.notes: opencode run --standalone with a custom OpenAI-compatible provider. Code Mode is the default route; codemode-off, execute-denied and protocol-2026-07-28 configs cover the direct path.

cline.title: Cline
cline.sdk: hand-rolled JSON-RPC on stdio (2024-11-05); @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.0 on http
cline.notes: The CLI is drivable; the VS Code extension needs a person. cline CLI (npm cline) with --yolo and an openai-compatible provider; a mock script ends the run through submit_and_exit.

fast-agent.title: fast-agent
fast-agent.notes: fast-agent go --quiet with a generic provider. Configs: default (auto), legacy, modern, anthropic, ptc (POSIX only, fails on Windows).

hermes-agent.title: Hermes Agent
hermes-agent.notes: Installed from git at the pin on Python 3.14; PyPI stops at 0.19.0.

pi.title: pi
pi.notes: pi --print with a custom openai-completions provider. Stock exposure is codemode; the default config sets exposure direct, codemode and deferred configs cover the stock routes.

kilocode.title: Kilo Code
kilocode.notes: VS Code extension; a CLI exists and may be drivable.

librechat.title: LibreChat
librechat.notes: A web app; its HTTP API may be drivable without a browser.

crewai.title: crewAI
crewai.notes: Agent(mcps=[MCPServerStdio|MCPServerHTTP]) on the native OpenAI provider; the crewai-tools config uses MCPServerAdapter (mcpadapt). Stdio server names are hashed into the tool name, so the adapter spawns a short wrapper.

deepagents.title: deepagents
deepagents.notes: The MCP route is deepagents-code (FastMCP proxy router + langchain.mcp); configs default, hooks, interpreter.

adk-python.title: Google ADK (Python)
adk-python.notes: Needs the Gemini API shape in the mock model. LlmAgent + McpToolset; configs default (Gemini, mock serves generateContent), anthropic (AnthropicLlm), modern (ADK_ENABLE_MCP_MODERN_PROTOCOL), strict-errors.

agent-framework.title: Microsoft Agent Framework
agent-framework.notes: Python only; one config per tool_result_content mode plus responses and anthropic. .NET not probed.
